sources.title: MEXC Blog — Zama's public token auction approaches: from 'privacy coins' to confidential computation (3 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Published 3 Dec 2025 (page shows a later modification date, 21 Apr 2026; only content consistent with a Dec 2025 view is used). Founded 2020 by Pascal Paillier (inventor of the Paillier scheme) and Rand Hindi. Unicorn after $57M Series B (Jun 2025); total funding >$150M. Roadmap: Ethereum mainnet Q4 2025, other EVM chains H1 2026, Solana H2 2026. >5,000 developers use Zama's FHE libraries (project figure); 20+ TPS per chain now, 100+ planned with GPUs; KMS uses 13 MPC nodes. Fees priced in USD, paid in ZAMA, $0.01–$1.30 per example operation. Zaiffer joint venture (€2M) for confidential tokens. Competitors named: Secret Network, Aztec, Oasis; ZK systems StarkNet, zkSync. Its allocation table was an estimate pending official disclosure and is not used.
